claim: L'Oustau de Baumanière address: Mas de Baumanière, 13520 Les Baux-de-Provence; weekly closure Wed–Thu.
quote: MAS DE BAUMANIÈRE 13520 Les Baux-de-Provence … Weekly closure every wednesdays and thursdays.

claim: Glenn Viel earned the 3rd Michelin star at L'Oustau on 27 Jan 2020 and retains 3★.
quote: On January 27, 2020, Chef Glenn Viel was awarded the 3rd Michelin star.

claim: L'Oustau de Baumanière is a three-Michelin-star restaurant in the 2025 Guide France.
quote: L'Oustau de Baumanière – Les Baux-de-Provence – a MICHELIN Guide Restaurant (three stars).

claim: Taxi Les Baux ↔ Saint-Rémy: ~11 min; average fare €48, low €30.
quote: From Les Baux-de-Provence to Saint-Rémy-de-Provence: average fare €48, best rate €30.

claim: Baumanière holds 3 Michelin Keys; 53 rooms across 5 buildings on 20-hectare Alpilles estate.
quote: Baumanière … 53 rooms spread over 5 buildings … 3 Keys.

claim: Baumanière is Relais & Châteaux, Green Key, 53 rooms across 5 living areas; Maison de Famille is a private 12–14 person villa.
quote: 53 rooms and suites spread across 5 living areas on the estate … Relais & Châteaux … 3 clefs Michelin.

claim: Baumanière is among the 24 inaugural 3-Key Michelin hotels in France (April 2024).
quote: Le premier palmarès Michelin hôtels français … 24 qui ont décroché 3 clefs.

claim: Domaine de Manville: 30 rooms + 9 villas, France's first eco-certified 18-hole golf, 100-hectare park at the foot of Les Baux; member Small Luxury Hotels of the World.
quote: 30 rooms and suites and 9 luxury villas … France's first eco-certified golf course … Small Luxury Hotels of the World.

claim: L'Aupiho (Domaine de Manville) is a one-Michelin-star restaurant, chef Lieven Van Aken.
quote: L'Aupiho – Domaine de Manville – Les Baux-de-Provence – a MICHELIN Guide Restaurant.

claim: Le Hameau des Baux is a 4-star Châteaux & Hôtels Collection property in Le Paradou with 21 rooms staged as a Provençal hamlet (square, fountain, chapel, plane trees).
quote: 21 rooms and suites … authentic hamlet, surrounded by a charming Provençal village square decorated with a fountain and shaded by plane trees.

claim: Le Hameau des Baux interiors designed by E&E Esprit XXe, mixing mid-20th-c pieces with new work; 5-ha olive grove, 5 min from Les Baux village.
quote: 5-hectare olive grove … five minutes from the village of Baux de Provence … interior design … E&E Esprit XXe.

claim: Mas de l'Oulivié: 4-star eco-hotel 2 km from Les Baux village, 25 rooms + 2 suites, olive-grove lagoon pool; member Hotels au Naturel and Teritoria.
quote: 2 km from the village … 25 rooms and 2 suites … swimming pool set inside an olive grove.

claim: Mas de l'Oulivié's annual closure runs 12 Nov 2025 – 26 Mar 2026.
quote: annual closure from November 12, 2025 until March 26, 2026.

claim: Hôtel Benvengudo: 4-star, 28 rooms/suites in a restored Provençal house with 4-hectare gardens, 5-min drive from Les Baux village.
quote: 28 rooms and suites in the heart of four hectares of flower garden … 5-minute drive from the beautiful village of Les Baux-de-Provence.

claim: Hôtel de Tourrel: 17th-c palais in central Saint-Rémy converted by an architect owner; 9 suites (down from 24 rooms), adult-only (13+), ClassiCon furniture (Eileen Gray, Konstantin Grcic).
quote: 17th-century palais … nine spacious suites … ClassiCon designers Eileen Gray and Konstantin Grcic.

claim: Hôtel de Tourrel is a Design Hotels™ member; open seasonally mid-March through late October.
quote: Member of Design Hotels … open seasonally from mid-March through late October.

claim: La Table de Tourrel (in Hôtel de Tourrel) is a one-Michelin-star restaurant; rooftop offers panoramic Alpilles views.
quote: La Table de Tourrel, a 1-Michelin star restaurant … Rooftop de Tourrel … panoramic views on the Alpilles.

claim: Château des Alpilles: 19th-c manor in 7-hectare park, 21 individually decorated rooms; literary-political guests included Lamartine, Thiers, Guizot.
quote: Pierre-Paul Blain had an imposing manor house constructed … Guizot, Lamartine, and Thiers … 21 uniquely decorated rooms … seven hectares.

claim: Château des Alpilles is listed as a Michelin Guide hotel in Saint-Rémy-de-Provence.
quote: Château des Alpilles – Saint Remy de Provence – Book a MICHELIN Guide Hotel.

claim: Mas de l'Amarine: 18th-c farmhouse 1 km from Saint-Rémy centre, art-led interiors (Roger Bezombes mosaics and palette), B&B feel with pool and seasonal restaurant.
quote: 18th-century farmhouse … mosaics and colors chosen by painter Roger Bezombes … a kilometre from the centre of Saint-Rémy-de-Provence.

claim: Mas de l'Amarine now operates as 3 private rental villas (Bastide du Levant, Bastide du Couchant, main Mas; 3 to 8 bedrooms), each with heated pool and pool house.
quote: Bastide du Levant – 3 bedrooms; Bastide du Couchant – 3 bedrooms; Mas de l'Amarine main house – 6-8 bedrooms.
